summary: Toast shows one notification at a time and lets it change as the agent's work moves on. A loading toast can turn into a success, and an error can offer Retry, all in the same spot on screen.
use: When an agent action needs a short confirmation, like "Changes applied" with an Undo button.
When a task starts as loading and you want the same toast to report the result.
When a failure needs a single clear next step, such as Retry.
When only the latest message matters and older ones should step aside.
features: Four tones: `success`, `error`, `info` and `loading`. Each picks its own icon and colour, and loading shows a spinner.
Give the toast a new `id` and the new one rises in while the old one slips away. Keep the `id` to update the text in place.
The `description` line crossfades when it changes, so progress text can update without a jump.
An optional `action` adds a button before the close button, in a `ghost` or `ink` style.
Set `action.busy` and the button label turns into a spinner. Clicks are ignored while it is busy.
The close button hides the toast straight away and calls `onDismiss`, even if your state has not cleared it yet.
a11y: Each toast has `role="status"` inside an `aria-live="polite"` slot, so changes are announced without interrupting.
The action button sets `aria-busy` while `busy` is true.
The close button has `aria-label="Dismiss"`, and a toast that is leaving is `inert`.
With reduced motion turned on, the exit animation is skipped and the text swap happens at once.

faq.q: Does the toast close itself after a few seconds?
faq.a: No, the component has no timer. Set `toast` to null from your own timeout when you want it gone. The demo does this for success and info, and pauses the timer on hover.

faq.q: How do I turn a loading toast into a success toast?
faq.a: Keep the same `id` and change `tone`, `title` and `description`. The card stays in place and the description crossfades. Use a new `id` if you want a fresh toast to slide in instead.

faq.q: How do I show a spinner on Retry while the agent tries again?
faq.a: Set `action.busy` to true. The button shows a spinner, gets `aria-busy`, and ignores further clicks until you clear it.
The toast hides itself when its close button is pressed, so `onDismiss` is for your own state. Clearing `toast` there keeps the two in sync.
